verdict.rationale: Terminal emulators can plausibly ship built-in AI agents that act as MCP clients, so this story applies to Ghostty. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP, plugging in tool servers, or any built-in AI agent. The documented automation surfaces (AppleScript, Apple Shortcuts, config/keybindings, libghostty) are adjacent features, not MCP client support, so they earn no credit.
